comment: Place at public/firmware/manifest.json. The key for each model MUST match the hw string the device reports in its BLE hello packet. Model V (Build B / Everything-in-C, Rev C board) reports hw:"V"; it reported hw:"III.I" before fw 1.3.3-c, which matched no key here and silently disabled OTA for that device. 'version' is compared against the device's reported fw with semantic ordering (parseInt per component, so a "-c" suffix is ignored); 'file' is the path (relative to the web root) of the raw .bin image. Bump 'version' and replace the .bin to ship an update.

IV.notes: native-C · identity LED + OTA auth gate + version-report fix. Served .bin unchanged from 1.4.2 test — 1.4.3 is a trigger bump to test the pipelined fast-OTA transfer (app-side change only).

V.notes: native-C · Rev C board · ADXL372 impact accel, ODR 400 Hz / BW 200 Hz, HPF on · NDJSON notify framing · OTA auth gate (HMAC-SHA256 challenge-response). 1.4.3-c fixes idle accelerometer sampling: scan_task's disconnected branch slept through a single 20 ms vTaskDelay, so the accelerometer ran at 50 Hz against a 400 Hz ODR and a 5-15 ms strike fell between samples — measured on TS-A090 2026-09-21 as ZERO impacts from repeated real strikes. Now 448 Hz counted, and 16 of 16 strikes detected with peaks scaling 5.12-14.86 g. Carries the 1.4.2-c monotonic "seq" on impact records (read gaps with impact_seq_gaps() in supabase/accel_events_seq.sql) and adds accel_hz= to the 1 Hz status line. 1.4.2-c never shipped past the bench. app ELF SHA256 ee5810c3a9379987…, idf v5.2.1.
